name: Spanish Inquisition
short_desc: A royal tribunal prosecutes religious offenses and enforces Catholic orthodoxy in Spain and its territories.
date_note: Authorized in 1478; inquisitors were appointed in 1480. Abolished and restored more than once before final abolition in 1834; the overall bounds are institutional, not an uninterrupted series of trials.
notes: Initial article identity, date meaning and source review completed. Summary authored for this catalog; independent claim-specific citations remain open.
